rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the final result of a series of events or actions.

example.english: The culmination of all our efforts was finally winning the championship.
example.traditional: 一連串努力嘅結果，就係我哋終於攞到冠軍。
example.jyutping: jat1 lin4 cyun3 nou5 lik6 ge3 git3 gwo2 zau6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 lo2 dou3 gun1 gwan1

rows.note: Use this when focusing on how a process, situation, or story ends rather than on its result as an achievement.

example.english: After all that, the culmination was that the matter simply fizzled out.
example.traditional: 搞咗咁耐，件事嘅結局竟然係不了了之。
example.jyutping: gaau2 zo2 gam3 noi6 gin6 si6 ge3 git3 guk6 ging2 jin4 hai6 bat1 liu5 liu5 zi1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the sum or total produced by adding separate amounts together.

example.english: The culmination of the amounts on these bills is three thousand dollars.
example.traditional: 呢幾張單嘅總和係三千蚊。
example.jyutping: ni1 gei2 zoeng1 daan1 ge3 zung2 wo4 hai6 saam1 cin1 man1
